"""Text helpers shared by the API layer."""

import re

_PUNCT = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")


def slugify(value, max_length=40):
    """Turn a title into a URL slug."""
    slug = _PUNCT.sub("-", value.strip().lower()).strip("-")
    return slug[:max_length]

"""Text helpers shared by the API layer."""

import re

_PUNCT = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")


def slugify(value, max_length=40):
    """Turn a title into a URL slug."""
    slug = _PUNCT.sub("-", value.strip().lower()).strip("-")
    if len(slug) <= max_length:
        return slug
    # If we need to truncate, try to break at word boundaries
    truncated = slug[:max_length]
    # Find the last dash to avoid cutting in the middle of a word
    last_dash = truncated.rfind('-')
    if last_dash > 0:
        return truncated[:last_dash]
    return truncated
